summary: Authentication administration: axiom auth adds roles, permissions and assignments, organizations and their members, invitations, user deletion, factor removal, sessions, export and send-verification, the audit trail, email delivery and suppressions, custom SMTP, email templates, provider removal, trusted-issuer update and remove, the policy releases list, axiom auth enable and disable, and axiom auth mfa set, each calling the same endpoint as the dashboard. --project resolves a slug, id or exact display name in your current organization, and --org with an exact project slug selects a project in another organization. Email template text is read from files or stdin, never from arguments, and is hidden by default: commands print metadata and a SHA-256 digest, and --reveal-text prints the text.
